newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Pertamina extends oil sharing contracts.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Pertamina extends oil sharing contracts.

text.p: Indonesian state-owned oil company Pertamina said on Monday it had extended oil production contracts with Santa Fe Energy Resources and Asamera Overseas Limited, a subsidiary of Gulf Canada Resources, for 20 years each.
Pertamina's Director of Exploration Prijambodo Muljosudirdjo told reporters that the Santa Fe contract, relating to an offshore block in Irian Jaya province, would be extended until 2020.
The Asamera contract, relating to a block in South sumatra would be extended until 2023, he said.
Muljosudirdjo also said Pertamina signed three new oil-production contracts on Monday.
One, for the Sibolga block offshore northern Sumatra, was signed with U.S. oil major Chevron and Texaco, he said. No details of the contracts were immediately available.
Another contract had been signed with Eurafrep Nederland BV for an onshore block in central Java, Muljosudirdjo said.
A third contract, with Canadian Petroleum Indonesia Ltd, was signed for an offshore block in the Molucca Islands, he said.
